name: @mavis/mcoded
description: Resident mcoded daemon (W10 product composition): unix-socket listener with launchd-style LISTEN_FDS adoption, the pi-rpc-semantics JSONL wire (prompt/steer/follow_up/events with version, cursor, request-id and bounded pagination) over pluggable transports, the bounded event replay ring backed by a durable event log (replay survives restarts), request-id dedup for retried mutations, crash-only checkpoint recovery and graceful drain shutdown. The live agent runtime plugs in through the RuntimeAdapter seam: LocalRuntimeV2Adapter drives the local-runtime-v2 conversation pipeline and is the hybrid default (MCODED_RUNTIME=echo keeps the legacy skeleton; unknown values fail startup — never a silent downgrade) — it inherits the selected profile's OAuth lease (--profile / MINIMAX_PROFILE), keeps the managed bearer synced for the model resolver, resolves the config default model to an available route model, and relays a failed turn (terminal session_status error) as an explicit turn_failed event.
